title: Segment Distance and the Summit Miles Upgrade Co-Pay
content:
In the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program, the distance of the upgraded segment sets the co-pay to charge for a cleared miles upgrade. The distance is the segment distance recorded on the upgrade request the clearance fulfils; it is compared with the segment length threshold that the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter sets for that ticket.

**Clause.** The distance treatment sets the co-pay to charge from the shared co-pay, before any amount is taken off it. The shared co-pay is the tier's miles upgrade co-pay per segment multiplied by the co-pay share percent.

- A segment longer than twice the threshold: the co-pay to charge is set at the shared co-pay plus a flat surcharge of 40 USD, the surcharge being capped at the shared co-pay itself; no multiplying.
- A segment longer than the threshold and up to twice it: the co-pay to charge is set at the shared co-pay multiplied by 1.5, rounded up to the whole dollar.
- A segment up to the threshold: the co-pay to charge is kept at the shared co-pay.

### Worked figures (hypothetical threshold of 1500 miles)

| Segment distance (miles) | Shared co-pay (USD) | Co-pay to charge set by this clause (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 3200 | 56.25 | 96.25 (surcharge of 40) |
| 3200 | 37.50 | 75.00 (surcharge capped at 37.50) |
| 3000 | 56.25 | 85 (84.375 rounded up) |
| 2000 | 75.00 | 113 (112.50 rounded up) |
| 1500 | 56.25 | 56.25 |

A segment exactly at twice the threshold is in the middle band; a segment exactly at the threshold keeps the shared co-pay.
